findings.text: follow-on: the ValueError skip added by fdbde9e07 is exercised by no test, so a regression turning an unclassifiable sibling back into a raise would not redden any id.

follow-on: the except-OSError branch returns True (identity unique), so if the canonical root cannot be listed a genuine duplicate resolves to the canonical file silently instead of raising, diverging from the scan it defers to.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits (05f3b87f5, fdbde9e07) against base 40186023d; they change only reckon/resources.py (+44/-2), adding the bounded duplicate check and its unclassifiable-sibling skip.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_dispatch_speed.py::test_plan_estimate_cache_tracks_edits_and_duplicate_identity; the manifest records logs/gate.log 23 passed EXIT=0, the two arm logs (base 1 failed / after 157 passed) and names 1500780fa as the commit that added the direct canonical read.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to restore duplicate plan detection so the estimate cache test's twice-filed plan is refused; reckon/resources.py:663 makes _resolve_canonical defer to the scan (return None) whenever _canonical_identity_is_unique (reckon/resources.py:668) finds another claimant of the same type+slug+archived in the canonical file's own root.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete at fdbde9e07, recording gate 23 passed EXIT=0, negative control EXIT=1, base arm 1 failed / after arm 157 passed, with the target id as the sole base failure.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (reckon/resources.py, tests/test_dispatch_speed.py, an evidence fragment, a figure directory); the two-commit diff changes only reckon/resources.py, inside them.

justifications.durability: the pre-existing tests/test_dispatch_speed.py::test_plan_estimate_cache_tracks_edits_and_duplicate_identity fails DID NOT RAISE once _canonical_identity_is_unique is forced True (logs/negative_control.log), but the fdbde9e07 error branches at reckon/resources.py:685 and :692 have no test.
justifications.evidence: the gate id passes at head (logs/gate.log 23 passed EXIT=0) and fails DID NOT RAISE at base (logs/baseline_suite.log 1 failed; logs/negative_control.log EXIT=1), with the negative control logged under the run directory as the done_when requires.
justifications.fit: the helper at reckon/resources.py:668 is named and documented by mechanism, matching _canonical_resource_at (reckon/resources.py:576) and _preferred_resource (:565), with no plan label or attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/resources.py:663 invokes _canonical_identity_is_unique before returning the canonical candidate, so a duplicated slug makes resolve_resource fall through to the scan that raises ResourceCollision at reckon/resources.py:710.
justifications.reuse: it extends the classifier identify_resource (reckon/resources.py:276) and the preference rule _preferred_resource (:565) rather than reimplementing them, and no owner of a bounded same-root claimant list exists (reckon/capabilities.py:59 and reckon/project_state.py:905 glob a typed root for different purposes).
justifications.scope_discipline: the only path in the two-commit diff is reckon/resources.py, inside the declared write paths, carrying nothing the goal does not imply.
